# retro-larper

retro-larper gives Obsidian a CRT-inspired retro look. Three palettes, Amber, Green and Ice, are selected through the Style Settings plugin, and only a dark mode is recorded.

![retro-larper screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hatemecha/retro-larper/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "retro-larper"
    author: "hatemecha"
    repo:   "hatemecha/retro-larper"
    slug:   "retro-larper"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/retro-larper"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hatemecha/retro-larper"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hatemecha/retro-larper/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a CRT-inspired retro look to Obsidian. Pick between Amber, Green, and Ice palettes using the Style Settings plugin."
}
```
